To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the process of measuring and improving business process performance is a continuous process, (2) business process performance is not a single measure but a combination of several measures, (3) the measures are not equally important and (4) the measures should be tailored to the individual company.

(1) the process of process evaluation is a complex one, (2) process evaluation is a process that can be evaluated, (3) the evaluation of processes can be improved through the use of a structured approach, (4) the use of the structured approach can be improved through an understanding of the underlying processes and (5) the use of a standardized evaluation process can improve the evaluation of processes.

(1) process improvement initiatives are not a one-time event, but a continuous improvement process, (2) process performance is the result of the process itself as well as the context in which the process is embedded, and (3) the process performance of a process is a function of the process itself, the process context and the process improvement initiatives that have been implemented.

the evaluation of business processes has a significant impact on the improvement and optimization of business processes.
